pages.text: A paved square 480 blocks from where you first appeared: a command center, depots, barracks, factory, starport, engineering bay, bunker and turrets. An SCV builds and stays by the building; buildings lift off and land.
Under the base lies a steel labyrinth with labs and a reactor core. Terrans claim land with concrete, lamps and cables; their camps have a campfire, a forge and an antenna, guarded by marines.
